venueScores.summary: The Walter Kerr Theatre offers excellent sightlines and sound quality, making it a great venue for intimate productions. accessibility.notes: No elevators. All accessible seating on Orchestra level. Infrared headsets and audio induction neck loops.

Winter Garden Theatre.tips: A grand theater with a distinctive wide auditorium. Home to Cats for 18 years. Recently renovated with improved comfort and accessibility.

seating.bestSeats: The Winter Garden is a wide theater, so aim for seats in the center orchestra to get the best view of the stage. Mezzanine seats can also offer a good overall perspective.
seating.avoidSeats: Seats far to the side in the orchestra or mezzanine may have obstructed views due to the theater's width.
seating.accessibility: 20 wheelchair spaces (largest of Shubert theaters). 16 aisle transfer seats. Infrared devices available.

sections.rationale: Choose center-left or center-right seats in rows A-C for some of the theater’s best views. They are especially strong if you prefer an elevated perspective. The front two to three center mezzanine rows provide a clear view of the stage without being too close.

venueScores.summary: The Winter Garden Theatre offers excellent legroom and spacious seating, making it one of the most comfortable venues on Broadway. The theater's ambiance is enhanced by its historical charm and garden-themed decor, while facilities are average with some potential for lines at restrooms.
